points.quote: Driftwood and Fall FSR Deactivation of bypassed road sections, between 82 and 95km Driftwood FSR
The Teegee Creek crossing is a 15.2m clear-span bridge, which is located at 92.8 km on the Driftwood FSR.
There is a 2800mm culvert on this site, which is located at 0.1 km on the Fall FSR.
at 4.3 km on the Fall FSR.

map_readings.label: DRIFTWOOD 7822.01
map_readings.shows: Road label printed on the brown forest service road line in the upper left of the map.

map_readings.label: FALL 7785.01
map_readings.shows: Road label printed on the brown forest service road line in the upper right of the map, near Diver Lake.

map_readings.label: Deleted_section_of_Driftwood_FSR
map_readings.shows: An orange line (legend: Deleted_section_of_Driftwood_FSR) running from the G5-024A crossing east and then south, rejoining the brown road north of the G5-023 symbol; a light orange line (legend: portion_of_RP_rolled_over_to_Driftwood_FSR) runs alongside it as the new alignment.

map_readings.label: Deleted_section_of_Fall_FSR
map_readings.shows: A purple line (legend: Deleted_section_of_Fall_FSR) running from near the G5-060 symbol north and east to the G5-061 symbol on the Fall FSR; a light green line (legend: portion_of_RP_rolled_over_to_Fall_FSR) joins at G5-061.

map_readings.label: G5-024A
map_readings.shows: A green structure (bridge) symbol on the orange deleted Driftwood FSR section, beside Cheztainya Lake.

map_readings.label: G5-060
map_readings.shows: A yellow structure (culvert) symbol beside G5-024A, at the start of the purple deleted Fall FSR section.

map_readings.label: G5-061
map_readings.shows: A yellow structure (culvert) symbol where the purple deleted Fall FSR section meets the brown Fall FSR line.

map_readings.label: LOVELL 7822.04
map_readings.shows: Road label near G5-024A; a teal line (legend: Driftwood_FSR_rolled_into_Lovel_FSR) runs north-west from near G5-024A past Cheztainya Lake. Not marked as deactivated.
